name: SPCAM3 Aquaplanet Simulation Data
size_as_stated: 17,927,168 samples for the training data, 3,556,800 samples for the validation data, and 2,752,512 samples for the offline test data
resolution: 64 latitude x 128 longitude x 30 vertical levels; 30-minute GCM timestep; embedded 2D CRM with 32 columns at 4-km horizontal resolution and 20-second timestep

scales.note: SPCAM3 aquaplanet; embedded CRM dx=4 km, GCM grid 64x128 (~2.8 deg / 312 km); 12 mo train + 2 mo val + 1 wk test = 433 days; 30-min output interval
